statement: The critical-partition create-lane over-target hold admits the planner-retained priority-spread cure ADD: holdCriticalPartitionCreateLaneIfOverTarget (rebalance-coordinator-priority-budget-admission.js) exempts an ADD-only move (never REPLACE) whose reason is spread_replicas, on a non-ledger priority control-plane partition, whose target node is not in the alive-occupied node set, while the alive-distinct-node count is below targetReplicaCount - the same conjunct the coordinator's own isEngagedPrioritySpreadCureMove already encodes one step later in ensureCreateTopologyGuardAllowed - computed from the alive-guarded inventory the hold already builds, so the planner and admission stop encoding contradictory policies at one knob. Verified at HEAD 60b8d0b6b (run public-path-multinode-baseline-20260811T135503Z): with 4 alive replicas over 2 distinct nodes and target 3x3, the planner yields the surplus REMOVE while retaining exactly one spread-cure ADD (retain_spread_cure_adds x718) and the hold refuses that ADD unconditionally (700x 'critical-partition create lane held' alternating with the retention log, one pair per cycle, all run) - a static coupled-invariant deadlock that pins priority spread at 2/3 forever; the hold's own transient-never-deadlock comment assumes a REMOVE the planner never emits. Bound stated honestly: one in-flight exempted ADD per partition (pre-existing add-like conflict gate, intent dedupe, TARGET_NODE_ALREADY_OCCUPIED guard), transient alive = current+1; reserves, CAS guards, drain selection, and the REPLACE hold untouched; convergence 5/3 -> drain -> 3/3 is witnessed in-run where the ADD escaped the hold by timing (control_plane_publications-p1, replica_operations-p1). Red-on-revert guard lands in the hold's home suite (rebalance-coordinator-topology-guard.test.js count-keyed lane tests) in both directions: cure ADD admitted; REPLACE churn and spread-satisfied over-target ADDs still held.
